description: This file contains unit tests for directory membership snapshot functionality in the Orleans distributed framework, including range ownership and ring coverage validation.

classes.name: DirectoryMembershipSnapshotTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests validating directory membership snapshot behavior, including owner retrieval, range intersection, and ring coverage.

methods.name: GetOwnerTest
methods.description: Tests that attempting to get the owner for a hash in the directory snapshot succeeds if and only if the snapshot has members.

methods.name: MembersDoNotIntersectTest
methods.description: Ensures that member ranges within the directory snapshot do not intersect.

methods.name: ViewCoversRingTest
methods.description: Verifies that the union of all member ranges comprehensively covers the entire ring.

methods.name: MemberRangesCoverRingTest
methods.description: Checks that the member ranges collectively cover the full ring, similar to ViewCoversRingTest.
